status: T05 proposed catalog for the first UI implementation; T06 publishes the keys in the core English dictionary, T07 adds renderer and accessibility keys, T08 adds binding, aggregation and configuration-lock keys, T10 adds comparison builder and delta-reason keys, T11 adds realtime status, simulation and control keys, and T17 completes all built-in locales

rules.namespace: lowercase namespace followed by dot-separated segments; diagnostic codes may use uppercase segments after diagnostic.
rules.fallback: English is the deterministic fallback; host overrides win over the selected built-in locale and English.
rules.interpolation: Placeholders use single braces with scalar parameter names and are escaped; translations are never assembled from fragments.
rules.hostData: Board titles, dataset labels, field labels and data values are host content and are not framework message keys.
rules.kpi: KPI and metric copy uses the editor.library.metric* and diagnostic.* keys; no separate metric.* or kpi.* keys are defined.
rules.diagnostics: Diagnostic keys use diagnostic.<CODE>; localized framework detail uses diagnostic.detail.<detail>. Host diagnostic detail is host content and is shown when its diagnostic declares source host.
